rows.notes: Quality-gated Qwen3.6 35B Quark W8A8 INT8 run on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70. Metric is p512/n512 streaming /v1/completions, temperature 0, four repeats after warmup. tokSOut is corrected steady-state output throughput after first streamed text chunk; e2e output mean was 98.16 tok/s. Frontdoor quality rerun8 passed exact canaries, JSON schema/semantics, copy phrase, 8K long-context needle, repeat stability, and baseline hash parity. Peak VRAM was not submitted because this run used --skip-vram.
